Looking at the documentation, I need to infer qlang verbs and syntax from the examples provided. Key patterns I can identify:

- `|` pipes values through steps
- `*` applies to each element
- `/field` accesses a field
- `filter`, `sort`, `group_by`, etc. are verbs (inferred from context)
- `eq`, `ne`, `lt`, `le`, `gt`, `ge` are comparison verbs
- `and`, `or` for logic
- Object literals `{:key value}` reshape data

Let me write queries for each task:

H1: /data | filter /active | filter /address/city | * /name | sort

H2: | filter (/status | lowercase | eq "paid") | * (/items | * (/qty * /price) | sum) | sum | round 2

H3: (/dependencies | entries) + (/devDependencies | entries) | filter (/[1] | startswith "^") | * (/[0] + "@" + /[1]) | sort

H4: | filter (/state eq "open") | group_by (/assignee/login or "unassigned") | to_entries | * {/[0]: (/[1] | count)} | from_entries

H5: . as $root | /services | filter (/enabled ne false) | * {name: /name, timeout: (/timeout or $root/defaults/timeout), retries: (/retries or $root/defaults/retries)} | sort

H6: | filter /durationMs | group_by /service | to_entries | * {/[0]: (/[1] | * /durationMs | avg | round 1)} | from_entries

H7: | filter (/stock gt 0) | sort_by /price | reverse | take 3 | * /name

H8: | group_by /dept | to_entries | * {/[0]: (/[1] | * (/skills or []) | flatten | * lowercase | unique | sort)} | from_entries

H9: | filter (/role | lowercase | eq "db") | all (/region eq "eu-west" and /cpu/cores ge 8)

H10: "Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | replace ";" "," | split "," | * (trim | split "@" | /[1] | lowercase) | unique | sort

H11: | split "\n" | * (split " ") | filter (/[3] ge 500) | * /[2] | group_by . | to_entries | sort_by (negate (/[1] | count)) | take 2 | * {path: /[0], count: (/[1] | count)}

H12: | split "\n" | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter (/[2] ne "") | group_by /[1] | to_entries | * {/[0]: (/[1] | * (/[2] | tonumber) | avg | round 2)} | from_entries

H13: | split "\n" | filter (. ne "" and not (startswith "#") and contains "==") | * (split "==" | {((/[0] | trim | lowercase)): (/[1] | trim)}) | merge

H14: | * {title: /title, total_likes: (/comments or [] | * (/likes or 0) | sum)} | sort_by (negate /total_likes) | /[0]/title
